findings.summary_md: Anthropic Frontier Red Team authors William Zhou and Daniel Freeman report experiments on small-model self-replication across consumer IoT hardware. A 9-billion-parameter model got inference running on 8 of 9 hardware types tested, and a 26-billion-parameter model split across 15 off-brand Android TV boxes ran at 0.39 tokens per second. In a closed network of eight emulated Android devices, GLM-5.2 completed the full replication cycle in four of five runs. The authors estimate models at or under 30 billion parameters could match this capability by the end of 2026 at historical improvement rates.
findings.title: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
